notes.title: New Version Live!
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work ironing out bugs that have been reported to us, and we've very grateful for everyone's input!
Additions:
[list]
[*] Mob SFX
[*] Mob Animations
[*] New music
[/list]
Thanks to the new additions battles are starting to come to life! Let us know what you think!
